decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that the panel reset button attaches through a connector rather than being mounted on the main board.

The panel-button mounting clarification is unrelated to the battery connector's family, pitch, contacts, accessibility, or unresolved pin order.
